## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant desktop/mobile and error states checked

## Community review & release

- Milestone / issue:
- Staging URL and exact commit:
- Risk / rollback plan:
- [ ] No secrets or private keys included
- [ ] Core changes have completed the 72-hour review after the latest push
- [ ] Blocking feedback is resolved
- [ ] Production status will be recorded separately from merged status

Do not connect a funded wallet or execute transactions as part of an automated test.
